records.stemEn: A 5-year-old boy develops acute hemolytic anemia after receiving trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. The smear shows blister cells. What is the most likely diagnosis?
records.explanationAr: وجود acute hemolysis بعد oxidant drug مثل sulfonamide مع blister/bite cells يوجه بقوة إلى G6PD deficiency. المصدر يذكر أيضًا Heinz bodies في supravital stain.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: Sickle cell disease وbeta-thalassemia لا ترتبطان بهذا trigger مع blister cells؛ hereditary spherocytosis تعطي spherocytes وليس النمط المؤكسد الكلاسيكي.
records.clinicalPearl: Oxidative stress in G6PD deficiency can produce Heinz bodies, bite cells and blister cells.
managementSteps: Assess severity of hemolysis and need for supportive care

image.captionAr: صورة peripheral smear الأصلية مهمة لإظهار blister cells.
image.captionEn: Original peripheral-smear image showing blister cells is required.

records.stemEn: A 3-year-old child has pallor and jaundice after a recent respiratory infection, a family history of anemia, and spherocytes on peripheral smear. Which test best confirms hereditary spherocytosis among the recalled options?
records.explanationAr: المصدر يختار osmotic fragility test من الخيارات، لكنه يذكر أن EMA binding هو الاختبار المفضل إذا كان متاحًا بسبب sensitivity/specificity الأعلى.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: Hemoglobin electrophoresis لاضطرابات hemoglobin، وDCT يفيد في immune hemolysis، وbone marrow aspiration ليس اختبار التأكيد المعتاد لـHS.
records.clinicalPearl: EMA binding is preferred when available; osmotic fragility remains a useful confirmatory test.
diagnosticSteps: Confirm with EMA binding if available
Use osmotic fragility if EMA is unavailable

records.stemEn: A 10-year-old boy has dark urine most noticeable in the early morning, anemia, low haptoglobin, splenomegaly, and a negative direct Coombs test. Which diagnosis best fits the vignette?
records.explanationAr: يوجد تعارض واضح داخل المصدر: المفتاح المطبوع يضع G6PD deficiency، لكن الشرح نفسه يصف PNH ويؤكد morning hemoglobinuria وintravascular hemolysis. لذلك لا يجوز نشر المفتاح A كإجابة صحيحة قبل التحقق.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر نفسه لا يقدم تبريرًا مقنعًا لـG6PD كإجابة، بينما وصفه التفصيلي يتجه إلى PNH. هذا السؤال High-priority review.
records.clinicalPearl: When the answer key conflicts with its own explanation, PediaRounds preserves the recalled key but blocks publication until verified.

records.stemEn: A patient has hemolytic anemia with elevated LDH and bilirubin and a direct antiglobulin pattern positive for IgG and C3, consistent with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia. What treatment was selected in the source?
records.explanationAr: المصدر يحدد corticosteroid كالعلاج الأول في warm AIHA ضمن الخيارات المذكورة.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: IVIG أو splenectomy أو plasmapheresis ليست الخيار الأول الذي اعتمده المصدر لهذا العرض المستقر.
records.clinicalPearl: Warm AIHA typically produces an IgG-positive DAT pattern; treatment depends on severity and stability.
managementSteps: Start first-line therapy according to verified guideline

records.stemEn: A patient with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia is tachycardic and unstable with hemoglobin 4 g/dL. Which emergency transfusion approach was selected in the source?

options.text: Transfuse the least incompatible available blood when urgently required
Give O-negative blood regardless of compatibility testing

records.explanationAr: المصدر يوضح أن transfusion لا ينبغي تأخيرها في life-threatening anemia لمجرد صعوبة compatibility testing، ويصحح العبارة إلى least incompatible وليس least compatible.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: إعطاء O-negative بشكل أعمى لا يلغي أهمية محاولة compatibility/alloantibody testing بالقدر الذي يسمح به الوقت.
records.clinicalPearl: Life-threatening anemia may require transfusion before complete compatibility workup is finished, with blood-bank support.
managementSteps: Do not delay lifesaving transfusion solely for prolonged compatibility testing
